options.counterfactual: The infimum is zero: every positive minimum-degree proportion guarantees a homomorphism to some finite triangle-free graph.
options.approach: Investigate an odd-girth reduction theorem that sends graphs with no triangles or pentagons and positive minimum-degree proportion to bounded triangle-free targets. Check its precise hypotheses before using it to establish the zero infimum.
